components.css: .ds-btn-primary { padding: 6px 14px; font-family: 'Source Sans 3', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.5; border: 1px solid var(--color-accent, #1e3a5f); border-radius: 4px; background: var(--color-accent, #1e3a5f); color: #fff; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-accent-hover, #254a75); border-color: var(--color-accent-hover, #254a75); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--color-chrome, #f7f5f0), 0 0 0 4px var(--color-accent, #1e3a5f); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.6; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Archive

components.name: Map list tabs

components.name: Map row
components.description: A Map list row. Selected is navy wash; hover is a 4% ink veil.
components.css: .ds-map-row { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; width: 100%; padding: 8px; border: 0; border-radius: 3px; background: transparent; color: var(--color-ink, #1c1917); font-family: 'Source Sans 3', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.35; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-map-row:hover { background: rgba(28, 25, 23, 0.04); } .ds-map-row.selected { background: var(--color-accent-wash, rgba(30, 58, 95, 0.1)); } .ds-map-row:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--color-chrome, #f7f5f0), 0 0 0 4px var(--color-accent, #1e3a5f); } .ds-map-title { font-weight: 600; } .ds-map-path { color: var(--color-ink-muted, #57534e); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }

components.name: Preview
components.description: GFM on Laid Paper. Serif reads; measure is 72ch.
components.html:
Remaining work

The Reader shows Wayfinder maps that live on disk. Success is understanding a Map or a Term without leaving.

Use Load once. Copy stays outline navy.
components.css: .ds-preview { max-width: 72ch; padding: 24px 0; background: var(--color-paper, #f4efe6); color: var(--color-ink, #1c1917); font-family: 'Source Serif 4', ui-serif, Georgia, serif; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.65; } .ds-preview h1 { margin: 0 0 0.4em; font-size: 1.75em; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.25; } .ds-preview p { margin: 0 0 1em; } .ds-preview a { color: var(--color-accent, #1e3a5f); text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 2px; } .ds-preview a:hover { color: var(--color-accent-hover, #254a75); } .ds-preview code { font-family: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.88em; background: var(--color-code-bg, #e8e3d8); padding: 0.15em 0.35em; border-radius: 3px; } .ds-term { text-decoration: underline dotted; text-decoration-thickness: 1px; text-underline-offset: 0.18em; cursor: help; }

narrative.overview:
Warm, quiet, workmanlike. Chrome recedes so the operator can stay in remaining work, a Map, or a Term. Personality lives in paper, ink, and navy, and in the serif/sans split — not in decoration.

The desk is a split surface: a stone **Map list** on the left, laid paper on the right. Source Serif 4 is what you read; Source Sans 3 is furniture (header, list, captions, controls). Chart Navy appears once as a filled Load. Copy, Paste, and Archive stay outline or ghost so they never compete with Load. Density is high in the list and generous on paper (72ch, 1.65 leading).

The shipped register is this light desk. Do not introduce a second world (cool OLED, different type, different chrome roles). Term hints stay in existing ink. The Map list is Sites and Efforts, not a file tree.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper / stone / pale chrome, one cool navy
Flat at rest; hairlines and tone do the depth
One filled Load; every other action is quieter
Term hints are dotted ink, never a second color

rules.name: The One Load Rule
rules.body: Chart Navy as a solid fill is Load, and only Load. Skip, Take, Paste, tabs, and chips may use navy as stroke or text. They never fill.

rules.name: The Warm Desk Rule
rules.body: Surfaces stay in the warm stone family. Do not cool the paper, chrome, or hairlines, and do not add a second accent hue.

rules.name: The Split Voice Rule
rules.body: Source Serif 4 is what you read. Source Sans 3 is what you operate. Do not set chrome in serif or running preview in sans, except the Paste composer (unrendered markdown) and preview placeholders.

rules.name: The Occupied Pane Rule
rules.body: Paste preview occupies the preview pane; it does not open a card, modal, or second column.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. The Term hint slip is the only drop shadow. Do not lift chrome, paper, or controls to “help” hierarchy.

rules.name: The Dotted Ink Rule
rules.body: Term hints decorate the current sentence. They do not speckle the page with Chart Navy.

dos: Do keep Load as the only Chart Navy fill on any given screen.
Do set GFM preview in Source Serif 4 at 16px / 1.65 on Laid Paper, 72ch.
Do set chrome, the Map list, and controls in Source Sans 3.
Do separate panes with Warm Hairline and tone (Pale Chrome / Stone Sidebar / Laid Paper).
Do mark Frontier with the inset 1px navy rule and the Frontier chip, not a glow.
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion: preview swap is 180ms opacity, or none.
donts: Don't add a second filled navy control (Copy, Paste, tabs, chips, Archive).
Don't turn the Map list into a filesystem tree.
Don't color Term hints or give them a second underline style.
Don't introduce a cool-OLED world, a different type pairing, or new chrome roles.
Don't drop-shadow header, sidebar, paper, or buttons. The hint slip is the exception.
Don't card the preview or the Paste composer.
Don't use radii above 4px, pills, or display type.
